items.title: Johnny Wiggs Interview, 1962-08-26
items.q: Bix and Trombaugh discovered Snoozer out at Paul Morese's house out on Metry Road.

ctx.x: Well, let me repeat that story that I wrote for Oren Blackstone's magazine one time. This is a cute little story. Bix and Trombaugh and Snoozer, by the way, of course, Snoozer was discovered by Trombaugh for Whiteman. Bix and Trombaugh discovered Snoozer out at Paul Morese's house out on Metry Road. One time when Paul Whiteman was in town, and they brought Snoozer back, and Paul Whiteman heard him and engaged him immediately. Well, when Snoozer was with Whiteman, I'll tell you two tales. One about a recording…
